notes: `בְּכֶפֶל` fused to 'within' under rule 30's preposition-plus-construct clause, headed on the construct noun; leaving `כֶפֶל` `unrepresented` beside a preposition holding the whole word is what that rule forbids.
`פְּנֵי לְבוּשׁוֹ` rendered attributively as 'his outer garment' under rule 28, with the ASV's literal gloss corroborating.
